# Security Policy

## Supported versions

The latest release only.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/tn3w/Shelf/security/advisories/new).
Please do not open a public issue.

Include the affected version, steps to reproduce and the impact you see. Expect a first
reply within seven days and a fix or a plan before any public disclosure.

## Scope

Shelf stores everything on the device and downloads only signed catalogue releases.
Relevant reports: data leaving the device, APK or catalogue integrity, file handling in
the reader, unsafe intent or storage access.
